post.originalText:
I asked Opus 5.5 to turn my work into a one minute film.

I've seen a lot of Opus 5.5 demos lately. 
All very impressive. 

But I kept thinking: 
apart from showing off what the model can do, 
what's one thing it can do for anyone that pays off right away?

Going forward, I don't think a portfolio or a web page is enough for anyone. 
You need a strong audiovisual piece that tells people in a minute what you've actually done. 
An elevator pitch one can watch.

This is my test. Opus wrote the edit as code. The footage is the real work.

It took two days of back and forth, mostly waiting..

Worth a try for anyone who has to introduce themselves.

What would you put in yours?

@claudeai
